answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in dawn, queued in nectar, and lotus publishes the wait time. A farm of 196 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3681 identities would post 996 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
